items.title: 太空侵略者
items.creator: Taito
items.note: 外星人逐行下压的节奏与心跳音效，是整个射击游戏类型的第一块奠基石。
items.noteEn: The descending alien march and heartbeat blips laid the foundation of the entire shooting genre.

items.title: 极速赛车
items.creator: Namco
items.note: 伪 3D 道路与排位赛机制，确立了整个竞速游戏类型的基本语法。
items.noteEn: Pseudo-3D roads and qualifying rounds fixed the basic grammar of the racing game.

items.title: 俄罗斯方块
items.creator: Alexey Pajitnov
items.note: 七种方块下落消除的最纯粹形式，几乎在任何硬件上都能完美运行。
items.noteEn: The purest falling-block puzzle; seven pieces, infinite depth, playable on virtually any machine.

items.title: 超级马力欧兄弟
items.creator: Nintendo R&D4
items.note: 顶砖、跳踩与秘密通道定义了平台跳跃的基本语汇，1985 年的 1-1 关是一代人的集体记忆。
items.noteEn: Brick-smashing, stomping and secrets defined the platformer's vocabulary — level 1-1 is a shared childhood.

items.title: 狂飙赛车
items.creator: Sega AM2
items.note: 选择岔路的磁带公路、夕阳配色与兜风气氛，定义了「开着车去度假」的浪漫。
items.noteEn: Branching roads, a convertible and sunset palettes defined the romance of a Sunday drive.

items.title: R 型战机
items.creator: Irem
items.note: 蓄力波动炮与可分离的强力装甲，把卷轴射击的战术深度推上前无古人的高度。
items.noteEn: A chargeable wave cannon and detachable Force pod pushed the side-scrolling shooter's tactical depth to new heights.

items.title: 超级马力欧兄弟3
items.creator: Nintendo R&D4
items.note: 变身、地图关卡与道具箱把马力欧从一关游戏升级成一场远征，是 8 位机的结构巅峰。
items.noteEn: Power-ups, an overworld map and item boxes turned Mario into an expedition — the NES's structural peak.

items.title: 模拟城市
items.creator: Maxis
items.note: 没有输赢、只有规划的「软件玩具」，城市模拟类型的起点。
items.noteEn: A software toy with no win state — only planning — where the city-builder began.

items.title: 零式赛车
items.creator: Nintendo EAD
items.note: Mode 7 伪 3D 的贴地飞行，用 15 秒一圈的极限速度定义了「快」。
items.noteEn: Mode 7 pseudo-3D flight 15 seconds a lap — the game that defined raw velocity.

items.title: 超级马力欧世界
items.creator: Nintendo EAD
items.note: 耀西、开关与幽灵屋的机关密度，加上存档与隐藏出口，是 16 位平台跳跃的完整体。
items.noteEn: Yoshi, switches and ghost-house tricks plus save files and secret exits — the 16-bit platformer complete.

items.title: 文明
items.creator: MicroProse
items.note: 从石器时代到星际航行的一声「再来一回合」，4X 策略的万恶之源。
items.noteEn: From stone age to spaceflight — the 'one more turn' origin of all 4X strategy.

items.title: 索尼克
items.creator: Sonic Team
items.note: 速度与环的物理，绿山区的卷轴滚动让『跑』第一次成为快感本身。
items.noteEn: Speed and ring physics — Green Hill's scrolling made running the pleasure itself.

items.title: 街头霸王2
items.en: Street Fighter II: The World Warrior
items.creator: Capcom
items.note: 定义了现代格斗游戏的八人可选阵容与必杀技输入，街机厅的一代神话。
items.noteEn: Eight selectable fighters and special-move inputs defined modern fighting games; an arcade legend.

items.title: 沙丘 II
items.en: Dune II: The Building of a Dynasty
items.creator: Westwood Studios
items.note: 鼠标框选、采矿造兵、雷达小地图——现代 RTS 的语法几乎都诞生于此。
items.noteEn: Mouse selection, harvester economy and a radar map — the grammar of the modern RTS was written here.

items.title: 超级马力欧赛车
items.creator: Nintendo EAD
items.note: 香蕉皮与红龟壳的四人对战，让「竞速」从此有了合家欢的入口。
items.noteEn: Banana-slip four-player chaos — the party game hiding inside a racer.

items.title: 德军总部 3D
items.creator: id Software
items.note: 用射线投射技术在 486 上画出可以走进去的城堡，第一人称射击的起点。
items.noteEn: Ray-casting drew walkable castle corridors on a 486 — the birthplace of the first-person shooter.

items.title: 毁灭战士
items.creator: id Software
items.note: 联网死亡竞赛的鼻祖，也是第一代让玩家半夜拔掉电话线只为多杀一局的游戏。
items.noteEn: The pioneer of networked deathmatch and the first game to make players yank the phone line at 2am.

items.title: 真人快打2
items.creator: Midway
items.note: 终结技升级为血池与断头等名场面，藏了 Jade、Smoke、Noob Saibot 三个秘密角色，把话题性炼成了真格斗游戏。
items.noteEn: Fatalities escalated to pit and spine-rip classics, with hidden fighters Jade, Smoke and Noob Saibot turning notoriety into craft.

items.title: NBA 嘉年华
items.creator: Midway
items.note: 二对二的街机篮球，夸张灌篮与「他着火了！」的解说成就了街机厅的疯狂。
items.noteEn: 2v2 arcade basketball with booming dunks and 'He's on fire!'; pure arcade mayhem.

items.title: NHL冰球94
items.creator: EA Canada
items.note: 一键传球与行云流水的滑行手感，被一代玩家与媒体奉为「史上最好的冰球游戏」。
items.noteEn: One-button passing and effortless skating flow — widely hailed as the greatest hockey game ever made.

items.title: 山脊赛车
items.creator: Namco
items.note: 首款把漂移当成艺术品的街机赛车，也是 PlayStation 的首发护航大作。
items.noteEn: The arcade racer that made drifting an art — and a PlayStation launch icon.

items.title: 模拟城市 2000
items.creator: Maxis
items.note: 地下管线、教育预算与通勤模型，让治理一座城市第一次如此令人着迷。
items.noteEn: Underground pipes, education budgets and commute models made running a city genuinely addictive.

items.title: 戴托纳美国
items.creator: Sega AM2
items.note: 「Rolling start!」的欢呼与三圈环道，是 Sega Model 2 基板时代最响亮的引擎声。
items.noteEn: The 'Rolling Start!' roar and tri-oval thrash — the loudest engine on Sega's Model 2 board.

items.title: 大金刚国度
items.creator: Rare
items.note: 预渲染 3D 建模转 2D 的画面革命，配合 Rare 的关卡密度，是 90 年代初的技术宣言。
items.noteEn: Pre-rendered 3D sprites and Rare's dense level design — the early-90s technical manifesto.

items.title: 地球冒险
items.creator: Ape & HAL Laboratory
items.note: 把美式小镇日常放进 RPG，电话存档与 PSI 让『战斗』第一次可以谈判与和解。
items.noteEn: American small-town life inside an RPG — telephones for saving, PSI powers that make battles negotiable.

items.title: 最终幻想6
items.creator: Square
items.note: 十四名角色的群像在帝国崩溃后各寻出路，魔大战的悲剧底色让『希望』有了分量。
items.noteEn: Fourteen party members search for purpose after an empire falls — tragedy gives every hope real weight.

items.title: 运输大亨豪华版
items.creator: Chris Sawyer
items.note: 用铁路网把整片大陆盘活，它的信号灯与经济模型至今仍被开源社区供养。
items.noteEn: A rail empire that breathes life into a continent — its signals and economy still thrive in open source.

items.title: VR战士2
items.creator: Sega AM2
items.note: SEGA Model 2 基板上的 3D 格斗教科书，没有飞行道具，纯靠走位与帧数判定立身，是写实格斗流派的原点。
items.noteEn: The Sega Model 2 textbook of 3D fighting — no fireballs, just footwork and frame data that founded the realistic branch.

items.title: 时空之轮
items.creator: Square
items.note: 穿越纪元、多结局与『新游戏+』，在 16 位机上做出了后来所有时间旅行 RPG 的样板。
items.noteEn: Era-hopping, multiple endings and New Game+ — the template every time-travel RPG still follows.

items.title: 命令与征服
items.creator: Westwood Studios
items.note: 真人过场与 GDI/Nod 的阵营对抗，让 RTS 第一次有了电影般的号召力。
items.noteEn: Live-action cutscenes and GDI-vs-Nod rivalry gave the RTS its first real star power.

items.title: 魔兽争霸 2：黑暗之潮
items.creator: Blizzard Entertainment
items.note: 海陆空三军与更顺滑的操作，确立了 Blizzard「易上手、难精通」的 RTS 路线。
items.noteEn: Naval, land and air forces with slick controls set Blizzard's easy-to-learn, hard-to-master RTS course.

items.title: 反重力赛车
items.creator: Psygnosis
items.note: 把锐舞文化与电子乐灌进反重力赛车，成为电玩潮流与时尚的标志。
items.noteEn: Anti-gravity racing fused with rave culture and electronic soundtracks — gaming's style icon.

items.title: 啪啦啪啦啪
items.creator: NanaOn-Sha
items.note: 把说唱节奏对战做成整个玩法，松浦雅也以纸片动画定义了节奏游戏。
items.noteEn: Rap-battle timing as pure gameplay; paper-cutout animation that defined the rhythm genre.

items.title: 宝可梦 红／绿
items.creator: Game Freak
items.note: 捕捉、培育与交换让收集本身成为叙事，151 只宝可梦是几代人共享的童年词表。
items.noteEn: Catch, train, trade — collection becomes narrative; 151 creatures form a shared childhood vocabulary.

items.title: 雷神之锤
items.creator: id Software
items.note: 真正的 3D 引擎让你第一次能低头看见自己的脚，也为竞技 FPS 立下准绳。
items.noteEn: True 3D let you look down at your own feet and set the benchmark for competitive FPS.

items.title: 超级马力欧64
items.creator: Nintendo EAD
items.note: 三维摇杆让马力欧第一次真正『跳』进空间，桃花公主城堡的开放式关卡是 3D 平台跳跃的源点。
items.noteEn: An analog stick put Mario truly in 3D — Peach's castle's open hub is the origin of the 3D platformer.

items.title: 最终幻想战略版
items.creator: Square
items.note: 伊瓦利斯大陆的政治权谋与转职系统，是日式战棋叙事的一座珠峰。
items.noteEn: Ivalice's political intrigue and job system — the Everest of Japanese tactical RPGs.

items.title: 最终幻想7
items.creator: Square
items.note: 魔晄都市米德加与克劳德的记忆拼图，让 JRPG 第一次认真谈起了身份与生态。
items.noteEn: Midgar and Cloud's fractured memory gave JRPGs their first serious take on identity and ecology.

items.title: 黄金眼 007
items.creator: Rare
items.note: 用一支 N64 手柄做出爆头、潜行与四人分屏，主机 FPS 从此不再只是 PC 的附庸。
items.noteEn: Headshots, stealth and four-player split-screen on one N64 pad — the console FPS finally came of age.

items.title: 跑车浪漫旅
items.creator: Polyphony Digital
items.note: 数百辆真实授权车与驾照考试，把「拟真驾驶」变成一项值得练习的技能。
items.noteEn: Hundreds of licensed cars and a license test that turned realistic driving into a skill worth mastering.

items.title: 铁拳3
items.creator: Namco
items.note: 把 3D 格斗的动作流畅度提升到新高度，被视为 PS1 上最完美的格斗游戏。
items.noteEn: 3D fighting rendered with unprecedented fluidity; often called the PS1's finest fighter.

items.title: 横扫千军
items.creator: Cavedog Entertainment
items.note: 数千单位同屏与全自动建造经济，把 RTS 的规模感整整抬高了一个量级。
items.noteEn: Thousands of units on screen and a self-building economy scaled the RTS up a full order of magnitude.

items.title: 热舞革命
items.creator: Konami
items.note: 街机脚垫踩出节拍的国民级音游，把游戏厅变成舞池。
items.noteEn: The arcade dance pad that turned game rooms into dance floors; a national rhythm institution.

items.title: 半条命
items.creator: Valve
items.note: 用脚本事件串起无缝叙事，把 FPS 从「清空房间继续走」变成一场发生在你身上的故事。
items.noteEn: Seamless scripted storytelling turned the FPS from room-clearing into a story that happens to you.

items.title: 合金装备
items.creator: Konami (Kojima Productions)
items.note: 躲过摄像头与脚步声、靠剧情过场推进的战术谍报，是潜入玩法与电影叙事的合流点。
items.noteEn: Camera-dodging, footstep-aware stealth driven by cinema — the confluence of infiltration and filmic storytelling.

items.title: 魂之利刃
items.creator: Namco
items.note: 刀剑格斗引入八方向移动，武器相克与判定精密，Dreamcast 首发护航之作，Metacritic 98 至今是格斗游戏之最。
items.noteEn: Weapon-based combat with eight-way-run movement and razor hitboxes; a Dreamcast launch title that still tops Metacritic at 98.

items.title: 星际争霸
items.creator: Blizzard Entertainment
items.note: 三个种族在平衡性上互相咬合，直接养大了韩国的电竞产业。
items.noteEn: Three races locked in exquisite balance — the game that built South Korea's esports industry.

items.title: 拳皇'98
items.creator: SNK
items.note: 3v3 组队制与「梦想对决」全明星阵容，SNK 把前两代系统打磨到极致，成为拳皇系列的竞技天花板。
items.noteEn: Three-on-three teams and a dream-match all-star roster; SNK's polished peak, still the series' competitive gold standard.

items.title: 塞尔达传说：时之笛
items.en: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
items.creator: Nintendo EAD
items.note: 把锁定视角、目标导向探索与『时之笛』的时间解谜编织成被反复临摹数十年的动作冒险语法。
items.noteEn: Wove lock-on combat, goal-driven exploration and a time-traveling ocarina into the action-adventure grammar still copied today.

items.title: 帝国时代 2：国王时代
items.en: Age of Empires II: The Age of Kings
items.creator: Ensemble Studios
items.note: 「伐伐伐伐木工」的钟声还在回响，它的战役手册读起来像半部中世纪史。
items.noteEn: Those woodcutter shouts still echo — its campaigns read like half a medieval history textbook.

items.title: 时空之轮 2
items.creator: Square
items.note: 六十余角色与平行世界的叙事野心，配以光田康典的竖琴与钢琴，是续作中罕见的艺术冒险。
items.noteEn: Sixty-plus characters across parallel worlds, scored by Mitsuda's harp — a sequel that dared to be art.

items.title: 异域镇魂曲
items.creator: Black Isle Studios
items.note: 文字量堪比小说，与『无名氏』的对话如同哲学论辩，证明 RPG 可以只靠文本抵达深渊。
items.noteEn: Novel-length prose and dialogue as philosophy — proof an RPG can reach the abyss with text alone.

items.title: 过山车大亨
items.creator: Chris Sawyer
items.note: 手绘像素加硬核经营，让「把游客甩晕再收门票」成了快乐源泉。
items.noteEn: Hand-drawn pixels and hardcore economics — spinning guests dizzy and charging them for it.

items.title: 莎木
items.creator: Sega AM2
items.note: 1999 年的横须贺有天气、工作与街机厅，铃木裕用预算把『生活感』浇灌成开放世界前史。
items.noteEn: 1999 Yokosuka with weather, jobs and an arcade — Yu Suzuki's budget made everyday life the proto-open-world.

items.title: 半人马座阿尔法星
items.creator: Firaxis Games
items.note: 把《文明》搬上外星球，七个阵营的剧情文本读起来像哲学宣言。
items.noteEn: Civilization on a hostile planet — seven factions whose texts read like philosophical manifestos.

items.title: 街头霸王3三度冲击
items.creator: Capcom
items.note: 「格挡」让攻守逆转只在一帧之间，Evo 2004 梅原大吾的背水逆转至今仍是格斗电竞赛事的传说。
items.noteEn: The parry flips offense and defense in a single frame; Daigo's Evo Moment 37 remains fighting-game esports folklore.

items.title: 命令与征服：红色警戒 2
items.creator: Westwood Pacific
items.note: 磁暴坦克与尤里的搞怪过场，把冷战梗做成了一部 B 级片狂欢。
items.noteEn: Tesla tanks and Yuri's camp cutscenes — the Cold War as an unhinged B-movie.

items.title: 反恐精英
items.creator: Valve
items.note: 从《半条命》模组变成职业电竞的地基，一把 AWP 的命准能改写整局经济。
items.noteEn: A Half-Life mod that became pro esports' bedrock — one AWP round can flip an entire economy.

items.title: 暗黑破坏神2
items.creator: Blizzard North
items.note: 随机地图、符文之语与刷宝循环，定义了 ARPG『再来一把』的诅咒，直到今天。
items.noteEn: Random maps, runewords and loot loops defined the 'one more run' curse that still rules ARPGs.

items.title: 马力欧网球
items.creator: Camelot Software Planning
items.note: N64 四人对战神器，强力扣杀与刁钻角度让菜鸟和高手在同一张网上找到乐趣，Metacritic 91 的合家欢巅峰。
items.noteEn: The N64's four-player killer app; power shots and sharp angles keep rookies and pros on the same court.

items.title: 漫画英雄VS卡普空2
items.en: Marvel vs. Capcom 2: New Age of Heroes
items.creator: Capcom
items.note: 3v3 换人加空中连段的高速大乱斗，56 名角色的狂野阵容把「助阵格斗」推到极致。
items.noteEn: Chaotic 3v3 tags and air combos; a 56-character roster that pushed assist fighters to their peak.

items.title: 完美黑暗
items.creator: Rare
items.note: 《黄金眼》的精神续作，把仿生机器人队友与复杂枪械改造塞进一张 N64 卡带。
items.noteEn: GoldenEye's spiritual sequel packed simulant bots and a deep weapon-lab into one N64 cart.

items.title: 塞尔达传说：梅祖拉的假面
items.en: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask
items.creator: Nintendo EAD
items.note: 三天循环倒计时让每个抉择都带代价，是系列里最黑暗、也最懂『时间』的一作。
items.noteEn: A three-day groundhog loop turns every choice into a sacrifice — the series' darkest meditation on time.

items.title: 模拟人生
items.creator: Maxis
items.note: 用几根「需求条」模拟日常琐碎，却让全世界玩家对虚拟小人产生真实同理心。
items.noteEn: Daily needs rendered as little bars — yet players worldwide felt real empathy for those pixels.

items.title: 托尼·霍克职业滑板2
items.creator: Neversoft
items.note: 加入抓板与手动组合的滑板游戏巅峰，连招系统至今仍是同类标杆。
items.noteEn: The skateboarding summit with reverts and manuals; its combo system remains the genre benchmark.

items.title: 高级战争
items.creator: Intelligent Systems
items.note: 像素小人、CO 技能与兵种相克压缩进一张 GBA 卡带，是回合制策略的教科书。
items.noteEn: Pixel troops, CO powers and a rock-paper-scissors counter system in a GBA cart — turn-based tactics distilled.

items.title: 鬼泣
items.creator: Capcom
items.note: 把『风格即难度』做成华丽连招秀，红墓城塔为动作游戏立下了技术标尺。
items.noteEn: Style-based combos made skill the difficulty — the game that set the bar for spectacle action.

items.title: 最终幻想10
items.creator: Square
items.note: 泰达对斯彼拉的陌生眼光就是玩家的眼光，尤娜的旅程以『反抗宿命』收束成泪水。
items.noteEn: Tidus' outsider gaze is the player's; Yuna's pilgrimage ends in tears against a scripted fate.

items.title: 侠盗猎车手3
items.creator: DMA Design
items.note: 自由城的三维街道首次允许『想去哪就去哪』，汽车与暴力从此成为开放世界的模板。
items.noteEn: Liberty City's 3D streets first let you go anywhere — cars and chaos became the open-world template.

items.title: 光环：战斗进化
items.creator: Bungie
items.note: 双武器、一颗雷与能量护盾的设计，让主机射击终于追上鼠标精度，也成就了 Xbox 首发。
items.noteEn: Two weapons, a grenade and a shield — the design that let console shooters finally rival the mouse.

items.title: 古堡迷踪
items.creator: Team Ico
items.note: 牵手系统把陪伴做成核心玩法，没有血条与菜单，却让逃生路每一步都像告别。
items.noteEn: Holding hands as core gameplay — no health bars, no menus, yet every step of escape feels like farewell.

items.title: NBA街头篮球
items.creator: EA Canada
items.note: 3v3 街头斗牛把 NBA 球星放进铁笼球场，花式运球与「灌篮火拼」比正代更自由奔放。
items.noteEn: 3-on-3 streetball drops NBA stars into cage courts; tricks and dunk battles feel freer than the sims.

items.title: 寂静岭2
items.creator: Team Silent
items.note: 把恐怖的重心从怪物转向内心的愧疚，雾镇里的每个怪物都是心魔的投影。
items.noteEn: Horror turned inward: the fog town's creatures are projections of guilt, not just monsters.

items.title: SSX 极限滑雪
items.creator: EA Canada
items.note: 把滑雪玩成花式特技的极限运动，快节奏与夸张动作定义了街头文化的爽快。
items.noteEn: Snowboarding as high-flying stunt spectacle; speed and audacity define its arcade soul.

items.title: 任天堂明星大乱斗DX
items.creator: HAL Laboratory
items.note: 把击飞百分比做成竞技深度的平台格斗，二十年后的职业赛场上依然活跃。
items.noteEn: Platform fighting where knockback percent breeds depth; still thriving on pro circuits decades later.

items.title: 托尼·霍克滑板3
items.creator: Neversoft
items.note: 新增的「回板」让连招在地面与空中彻底打通，Metacritic 97 至今是滑板游戏不可逾越的高峰。
items.noteEn: The revert bridged manual and air combos into one endless line; at 97 it remains the skate-game benchmark.

items.title: 银河战士 Prime
items.creator: Retro Studios
items.note: 第一人称把萨姆斯的孤独与异星恐惧装进扫描面甲与护甲界面，是 2D 银河城转向 3D 的教科书。
items.noteEn: First-person immersion wraps Samus' solitude in scan visors and suit readouts — the textbook 2D-to-3D Metroidvania.

items.title: 上古卷轴3：晨风
items.creator: Bethesda Game Studios
items.note: 没有任务箭头、只有文字日记，瓦登费尔的怪异生态逼玩家真正学会读地图。
items.noteEn: No quest markers, only a written journal — Vvardenfell's alien ecology forces you to actually read the map.

items.title: 魔兽争霸 3：混乱之治
items.creator: Blizzard Entertainment
items.note: 英雄单位与经验值让 RTS 有了 RPG 的心跳，也顺手埋下了 Dota 的种子。
items.noteEn: Hero units and XP gave the RTS an RPG heartbeat — and quietly planted the seed of Dota.

items.title: 超越善恶
items.creator: Ubisoft
items.note: 摄影记者打游击、偷拍与地下电台揭露谎言，反乌托邦寓言嵌在明亮的童话外壳里。
items.noteEn: A photojournalist runs an underground newsroom against a police state — a dystopian fable in bright cartoon clothes.

items.title: 零式赛车 GX
items.creator: Amusement Vision
items.note: 赛博朋克街机风格与地狱级难度，被公认为史上最硬核的高速赛车之一。
items.noteEn: Cyberpunk arcade style and brutal difficulty — arguably the hardest high-speed racer ever made.

items.title: 马力欧高尔夫：蘑菇杯巡回赛
items.creator: Camelot Software Planning
items.note: Camelot 把挥杆计量做得既严谨又任天堂式亲切，力度与风向的博弈让人一杆接一杆停不下来。
items.noteEn: Camelot's swing meter is demanding yet approachable — wind and power gambling that hooks for hours.

items.title: 极品飞车：地下狂飙
items.creator: EA Black Box
items.note: 霓虹街灯、改装文化与氮气加速，让午夜街头赛成为一代人的向往。
items.noteEn: Neon streets, tuning culture and nitrous boosts — midnight street racing as a generation's fantasy.

items.title: 波斯王子：时之砂
items.en: Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time
items.creator: Ubisoft Montreal
items.note: 时间倒带让失误变成创作素材，王子与公主的插科打诨让波斯宫廷有了人气。
items.noteEn: Rewind turns mistakes into material; the prince and princess' banter gives the Persian court real warmth.

items.title: 星球大战：旧共和国武士
items.en: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic
items.creator: BioWare
items.note: 原力、光剑与抉择，加上后期反转的身份谜底，是星战故事在 RPG 里的最佳形态。
items.noteEn: The Force, sabers and choices — capped by a mid-game identity twist — Star Wars' finest RPG form.

items.title: 横冲直撞 3
items.creator: Criterion Games
items.note: 把「撞毁对手」做成得分核心，每一次追尾都配有慢动作回放。
items.noteEn: Crashes as the scoring system — every takedown rewarded with a slow-motion replay.

items.title: 洞窟物语
items.creator: Studio Pixel
items.note: 天谷大辅一人耗时五年免费发布的同人游戏，被视为现代独立游戏的起点之一。
items.noteEn: Daisuke Amaya's five-year solo freeware that many call the birthplace of the modern indie scene.

items.title: CLANNAD
items.creator: Key
items.note: Key 社催泪三作的代表，小镇、家庭与光玉的叙事足以让人哭到透支。
items.noteEn: Key's tearjerker masterpiece; a town, a family and orbs of light that leave you emotionally spent.

items.title: 命运之夜
items.creator: Type-Moon
items.note: 圣杯战争与英灵召唤的宏大设定，直接催生了横跨十余年的超级 IP。
items.noteEn: The Holy Grail War saga whose worldbuilding spawned a multi-decade multimedia empire.

items.title: 侠盗猎车手：圣安地列斯
items.creator: Rockstar North
items.note: 三座城市与荒野、帮派地盘与健身系统，把开放世界的规模从街区扩大到生活方式。
items.noteEn: Three cities, gang turf and a gym system grew the open world from blocks to a lifestyle.

items.title: 半条命 2
items.creator: Valve
items.note: Source 引擎的物理谜题与重力枪，让场景里每一件杂物都能成为武器。
items.noteEn: The Source engine's physics puzzles and gravity gun turned every loose object into a weapon.

items.title: 光环 2
items.creator: Bungie
items.note: 双持武器与士官长/神风烈士双线叙事，也是 Xbox Live 联机体验的里程碑。
items.noteEn: Dual wielding and a two-sided narrative — the benchmark that defined Xbox Live multiplayer.

items.title: 音乐方块
items.creator: Q Entertainment
items.note: 方块消除跟随音乐节拍扫过，水口哲也把抽象拼图变成视听一体的冥想。
items.noteEn: Tetsuya Mizuguchi's puzzle where a beat-line sweeps away blocks, fusing matching with audiovisual trance.

items.title: 模拟人生 2
items.creator: Maxis
items.note: 加入生命周期与遗传系统，小人第一次会长大、老去并留下后代。
items.noteEn: Lifespans, genetics and generations — for the first time your sims aged, died and left heirs.

items.title: 恐惧
items.creator: Monolith Productions
items.note: 至今少有人及的敌人 AI——他们会包抄、会压制、会在走廊里设伏等你。
items.noteEn: Enemy AI few games have matched — they flank, suppress and ambush you in the hallways.

items.title: 吉他英雄
items.creator: Harmonix
items.note: 五键塑料吉他让普通人体验摇滚主唱的幻觉，直接引爆了音乐游戏热潮。
items.noteEn: A five-button plastic guitar gives everyone a rock-star fantasy; it ignited the rhythm-game boom.

items.title: 极品飞车：最高通缉
items.creator: EA Black Box
items.note: 警匪追逐与黑名单 15 人，把「被通缉」做成了最刺激的猫鼠游戏。
items.noteEn: Police chases and a Blacklist of 15 — being hunted made into the most thrilling cat-and-mouse.

items.title: 逆转裁判
items.creator: Capcom
items.note: 以「异议！」翻盘庭审的法庭推理，把调查、举证与嘴炮做成教科书式视觉小说。
items.noteEn: Courtroom deduction built on 'Objection!' turns; investigation and cross-examination as VN canon.

items.title: 实况足球9
items.creator: Konami
items.note: 实况系列公认的巅峰作，球员 AI 与传控手感至今仍被玩家怀念。
items.noteEn: The consensus peak of the Winning Eleven series; its passing and AI still feel years ahead.

items.title: 生化危机4
items.creator: Capcom
items.note: 过肩视角与体术击打把生存恐怖改写成动作射击，村庄一役定义了新世代的枪战节奏。
items.noteEn: Over-the-shoulder aim and suplexes turned survival horror into action — the village fight redefined shooter rhythm.

items.title: 旺达与巨像
items.creator: Team Ico
items.note: 去掉杂兵与小怪，十六场与巨像的一对一对话就是全部，空寂草原回响着『为谁而战』。
items.noteEn: Strips away minor enemies: sixteen one-on-one duels with colossi on an empty plain — the whole game asks for whom you fight.

items.title: 文明 4
items.creator: Firaxis Games
items.note: 宗教、公民制度与伦纳德·尼莫伊配音的科技树，是系列口碑的巅峰。
items.noteEn: Religion, civics and Leonard Nimoy-narrated tech quotes — the series' critical peak.

items.title: 恶霸鲁尼
items.creator: Rockstar Vancouver
items.note: 校园版 GTA，恶作剧、翘课与老师巡逻把青春期的压迫感做成开放世界喜剧。
items.noteEn: GTA set in a school — pranks, skipping class and teacher patrols turn teen pressure into open-world comedy.

items.title: 英雄连
items.creator: Relic Entertainment
items.note: 掩体机制与完全可摧毁的地形，让二战战术第一次有了真正的「地形感」。
items.noteEn: Cover mechanics and fully destructible terrain gave WWII tactics real spatial depth.

items.title: 矮人要塞
items.creator: Bay 12 Games
items.note: 用字符界面模拟一整座要塞的生态与传说，是游戏史上最深的模拟之一。
items.noteEn: A fortress's ecology and legends simulated in ASCII — among the deepest simulations ever made.

items.title: 精英节拍特工
items.creator: iNiS
items.note: 用触屏点按跟上旋律的特工小队，把真人照片故事演成荒诞又热血的音乐剧。
items.noteEn: Touch-screen agents dance to the beat through photo-real stories; a bizarrely heartfelt rhythm musical.

items.title: 微软模拟飞行 X
items.creator: Aces Game Studio
items.note: 一度是许多人心中的「飞行教科书」，也是装机党偷偷拿来测显卡的常客。
items.noteEn: For years a flight textbook, and the benchmark every PC builder secretly ran to test their GPU.

items.title: 大神
items.creator: Clover Studio
items.note: 以水墨笔触挥毫解谜与战斗，把日本神话装进一卷会呼吸的浮世绘，天照的画笔至今无二。
items.noteEn: Brush-stroke puzzles and combat painted in sumi-e ink — Japanese myth in a breathing ukiyo-e scroll.

items.title: 实况足球10
items.creator: Konami
items.note: 即日版《胜利十一人10》，把拟真传球与战术自由度做到系列巅峰，是 FIFA 全面反超前实况最后的荣光。
items.noteEn: Known as Winning Eleven 10 — the tactical peak of the series before FIFA caught up for good.

items.title: Wii 运动
items.creator: Nintendo
items.note: 用体感挥动 Wii 遥控器的全家同乐套装，是史上最畅销的电子游戏之一。
items.noteEn: Motion-controlled tennis, bowling and more; one of the best-selling video games of all time.

items.title: 生化奇兵
items.creator: Irrational Games
items.note: 水下乌托邦 Rapture 用一句「Would you kindly?」当众拷问玩家的自由意志。
items.noteEn: The underwater utopia of Rapture interrogates free will with one phrase: 'Would you kindly?'

items.title: 使命召唤 4：现代战争
items.creator: Infinity Ward
items.note: 把战场从二战拉回现代，AC-130 炮火支援与核爆序章把脚本演出推到电影级。
items.noteEn: Modern warfare, AC-130 gunship strikes and a nuke sequence that pushed scripted set-pieces to cinema.

items.title: 孤岛危机
items.creator: Crytek
items.note: 纳米服的隐身与力量模式、可摧毁的植被，成了当年「你的电脑跑得动吗」的终极拷问。
items.noteEn: Nanosuit stealth, strength modes and destructible jungle — the ultimate 'can your PC run it?' benchmark.

items.title: 光环 3
items.creator: Bungie
items.note: 士官长三部曲的收束，锻造模式与电影回放让玩家亲手制作自己的传奇。
items.noteEn: The Master Chief trilogy's finale — Forge maps and film replays let players author their own legend.

items.title: 质量效应
items.creator: BioWare
items.note: 把太空歌剧装进对话轮，谢泼德的选择在星系尺度的道德光谱上不断回响。
items.noteEn: Space opera via a dialogue wheel — Shepard's choices ripple across a galactic moral spectrum.

items.title: 传送门
items.creator: Valve
items.note: 用两个传送门改写空间与动量，GLaDOS 的黑色幽默让每个房间都难忘。
items.noteEn: Two portals rewrite space and momentum; GLaDOS' dark wit makes every chamber memorable.

items.title: 雷顿教授与不可思议的小镇
items.en: Professor Layton and the Curious Village
items.creator: Level-5
items.note: 把上百道脑力题装进优雅的欧式小镇谜案，谜题与叙事相得益彰。
items.noteEn: Hundreds of brainteasers folded into an elegant European mystery; puzzles and story lift each other.

items.title: 摇滚乐队
items.creator: Harmonix
items.note: 四人齐奏吉他、贝斯、鼓与麦克风的合奏体验，把客厅变成家庭乐队现场。
items.noteEn: Four-player guitar, bass, drums and vocals turned living rooms into a full family band.

items.title: 潜行者：切尔诺贝利的阴影
items.creator: GSC Game World
items.note: 把切尔诺贝利禁区做成 A-Life 生态模拟的开放世界，潮湿、残酷又莫名迷人。
items.noteEn: The Zone as a living A-Life ecosystem — damp, brutal and strangely magnetic.

items.title: 超级马力欧银河
items.creator: Nintendo EAD
items.note: 引力把平台铺成球形，管弦乐与宫本茂的『重力』实验让每一关都像微型太阳系。
items.noteEn: Gravity bends platforms into spheres; orchestral scores and Miyamoto's experiments make each level a tiny solar system.

items.title: 最高指挥官
items.creator: Gas Powered Games
items.note: 无限拉近又无限拉远的战略视图，让绵延数百公里的战场尽收一屏。
items.noteEn: Zoom from a single tank to a continent-wide battlefield — RTS scale reinvented.

items.title: 军团要塞 2
items.creator: Valve
items.note: 九个职业、漫画画风与每年一度的更新季，为「喜剧 FPS」立下了范本。
items.noteEn: Nine classes, a comic-book look and yearly updates — the template for the comedy FPS.

items.title: 428：被封锁的涩谷
items.creator: Chunsoft
items.note: 用真人影像推进 5 条并行故事线，实时连锁的抉择让涩谷一夜层层失控。
items.noteEn: Live-action vignettes across five interlocking timelines; one night in Shibuya spirals out of control.

items.title: 时空幻境
items.creator: Number None
items.note: 以时间倒流为核心机制的独立游戏里程碑，Jonathan Blow 用平台跳跃讲了一个关于悔恨的故事。
items.noteEn: The indie milestone that rewrote time-rewind mechanics, using platforming to tell a story about regret.

items.title: 死亡空间
items.creator: Visceral Games
items.note: 把肢解异形当作战斗核心的太空船恐怖，UI 全部融入世界观没有一处跳出。
items.noteEn: Space-horror where dismemberment is the core strategy; the UI lives entirely inside the diegetic world.

items.title: 侠盗猎车手4
items.creator: Rockstar North
items.note: 自由城被湿漉漉的写实压得喘不过气，物理与人际把黑帮叙事拉回地面。
items.noteEn: A rain-soaked, crushingly realistic Liberty City grounds the mob story in physics and human frailty.

items.title: 孢子
items.creator: Maxis
items.note: 从单细胞到星际文明的五阶段进化，把上帝视角玩成了物种养成。
items.noteEn: Five stages from single cell to spacefaring civilization — god games as species husbandry.

items.title: 赛道狂飙：国家永恒
items.creator: Nadeo
items.note: 免费联机的花样赛道编辑器，让「撞墙也能夺冠」的欢乐成了电竞赛事。
items.noteEn: Free-to-play stunt racing with a track editor — where crashing into a wall can still win the race.

items.title: 粘粘世界
items.creator: 2D Boy
items.note: 黏黏小球搭桥的解谜小品，物理互动与荒诞叙事开创了 Wii 平台独立游戏时代。
items.noteEn: Gloopy goo-balls and physics bridges with absurdist wit; it opened Wii to the indie scene.

items.title: 刺客信条2
items.creator: Ubisoft Montreal
items.note: 文艺复兴的佛罗伦萨与威尼斯成了跑酷舞台，埃齐奥的成长线让刺客信条有了灵魂。
items.noteEn: Renaissance Florence and Venice as parkour arenas — Ezio's arc gave Assassin's Creed its soul.

items.title: 蝙蝠侠：阿卡姆疯人院
items.creator: Rocksteady Studios
items.note: 『侦探视觉』与斯巴达式潜行把蝙蝠侠还原成黑夜中的猎手，疯人院本身就是会说话的迷宫。
items.noteEn: Detective vision and predator stealth make Batman a hunter in the dark — the asylum itself is a talking maze.

items.title: 猎天使魔女
items.creator: PlatinumGames
items.note: 以舞步编排枪术与召唤，贝优妮塔的夸张姿态把动作游戏做成了一场午夜嘉年华。
items.noteEn: Dance-choreographed gunplay and demon summons — Bayonetta turns action into a midnight carnival.

items.title: 龙腾世纪：起源
items.creator: BioWare
items.note: 六种起源开场与战术 AI 编程，把《博德之门》的血统推进了实时暂停的新世代。
items.noteEn: Six origin stories and tactical AI scripting carry Baldur's Gate's lineage into the real-time-with-pause era.

items.title: 初音未来：歌姬计划
items.creator: Sega
items.note: 让虚拟歌姬在精致 PV 中登台演唱的按键音游，把 Vocaloid 文化带向大众。
items.noteEn: Tap to the beat as virtual idol Miku performs in gorgeous PVs; it carried Vocaloid culture mainstream.

items.title: 舞力全开
items.creator: Ubisoft
items.note: 用体感识别跟着热门单曲起舞，派对与家庭聚会的万能暖场神器。
items.noteEn: Motion-tracking dance to chart hits; the surest way to warm up any party or family gathering.

items.title: 杀戮地带 2
items.creator: Guerrilla Games
items.note: 沉重的手感与暴烈的粒子效果，把「战争的重量」压进每一次扣扳机。
items.noteEn: Weighty gunplay and ferocious particle effects put the sheer weight of war behind every trigger pull.

items.title: 求生之路 2
items.creator: Valve
items.note: AI 导演会偷看你的血量临时调整尸潮，让每一次通关都像第一次那么紧张。
items.noteEn: The AI Director peeks at your health and reshuffles the horde, so no run ever plays the same.

items.title: 命运石之门
items.creator: 5pb.
items.note: 微波炉改造成时光机的时间旅行叙事，从日常喜剧到绝望螺旋的转换教科书。
items.noteEn: A microwave time machine and the cost of every 'D-Mail'; the canonical descent from comedy to despair.

items.title: 神秘海域2：纵横贼道
items.creator: Naughty Dog
items.note: 把电影式过场与攀爬枪战无缝衔接，火车与藏地雪山的场面调度至今仍是第三人称动作的标杆。
items.noteEn: Seamless set-piece cinema — trains and Himalayan chases — still the benchmark for third-person spectacle.

items.title: Wii运动：度假胜地
items.creator: Nintendo EAD
items.note: Wii MotionPlus 让挥剑与掷飞盘有了真实位移，剑术决斗成为 Wii 时代最棒的体感社交。
items.noteEn: MotionPlus adds real motion to swordplay and disc toss — sword duels are the Wii's best motion-social experience.

items.title: 心灵杀手
items.creator: Remedy Entertainment
items.note: 以手电筒驱散黑暗的湖畔小镇惊悚，把创作焦虑与电视剧式分集叙事结合。
items.noteEn: Flashlight-lit dread in a lakeside town, fusing creative anxiety with TV-style episodic pacing.

items.title: 失忆症：黑暗后裔
items.creator: Frictional Games
items.note: 没有武器、只能逃跑与躲藏的第一人称恐怖，奠定了「逃生恐怖」的模板。
items.noteEn: First-person terror with no weapons, only hiding; it codified the run-and-hide survival horror template.

items.title: 弹丸论破：希望的学园与绝望高中生
items.creator: Spike Chunsoft
items.note: 黑白熊的互相残杀学级裁判，把日常推理、法庭辩论与「论破」炫技结合。
items.noteEn: Monokuma's killing game: slice-of-life, courtroom debate and 'breaking' contradictions in one trial.

items.title: 辐射：新维加斯
items.creator: Obsidian Entertainment
items.note: 莫哈维废土的阵营之间没有纯善，凯撒军团与 NCR 的选择把冷战宿命塞进点 44 口径。
items.noteEn: No clean side in the Mojave — Caesar's Legion vs. the NCR stuffs Cold War destiny into .44 rounds.

items.title: 质量效应2
items.creator: BioWare
items.note: 以『忠诚任务』做角色驱动，自杀任务的倒计时让每段羁绊都可能在终点前断裂。
items.noteEn: Loyalty missions make it character-driven — the suicide run's countdown can sever any bond before the end.

items.title: NBA 2K11
items.creator: Visual Concepts
items.note: 「乔丹挑战模式」重现飞人的十场传奇比赛，把怀旧与拟真手感缝合，是 2K 系列的封神一作。
items.noteEn: The Jordan Challenge replays ten MJ legends, fusing nostalgia with sim polish — the 2K series' masterpiece.

items.title: 极限脱出 9小时9人9之门
items.en: Nine Hours, Nine Persons, Nine Doors
items.creator: Spike Chunsoft
items.note: 密室逃脱谜题与多重结局交织的数字根谜团，第九人身份的反转令人拍案。
items.noteEn: Escape-the-room puzzles wired into a digital-root conspiracy; the ninth-person twist stuns.

items.title: 荒野大镖客：救赎
items.creator: Rockstar San Diego
items.note: 荒野西部的黄昏，马背上的长镜头与约翰·马斯顿的还债之旅是工业时代的挽歌。
items.noteEn: The Old West at dusk — horseback long shots and Marston's debt-paying ride are an elegy for an industrial age.

items.title: 文明 5
items.creator: Firaxis Games
items.note: 六边形格与「一单位一格」的改动，彻底重写了系列的地图逻辑。
items.noteEn: Hex tiles and one-unit-per-tile reinvented the series' map logic from the ground up.

items.title: 超级马力欧银河2
items.creator: Nintendo EAD
items.note: 把一代的奇想浓缩成更密、更硬的核心关卡，耀西加入后连行星都能骑。
items.noteEn: Distills the first game's wonder into denser, harder core levels — and you can ride Yoshi on planets.

items.title: 超级食肉男孩
items.creator: Team Meat
items.note: 以像素级精确操作与海量关卡闻名的硬核平台跳跃，开创了本世代 roguelike 平台游戏的先河。
items.noteEn: A razor-precise hardcore platformer whose tight controls and massive level count redefined indie action.

items.title: 异度神剑
items.creator: Monolith Soft
items.note: 站在两具巨神身上看世界的科幻神话，自动战斗与广阔地图是新一代 JRPG 的宣言。
items.noteEn: A world staged on two sleeping titans — auto-attacks and a vast map declare the next-gen JRPG.

items.title: 堡垒
items.creator: Supergiant Games
items.note: 旁白叙述随玩家行动实时生成的等距动作 RPG，Supergiant 的第一款作品一鸣惊人。
items.noteEn: An isometric action-RPG whose narrator reacts to your every move in real time; Supergiant's dazzling debut.

items.title: 蝙蝠侠：阿卡姆之城
items.creator: Rocksteady Studios
items.note: 把疯人院扩成一座露天监狱城，空中滑翔与全息案件档案让哥谭第一次有了实体。
items.noteEn: Expands the asylum into an open-air prison city — gliding and holographic case files give Gotham physical weight.

items.title: 子弹风暴
items.creator: People Can Fly
items.note: 用鞭子把敌人甩进仙人掌再补一记飞踢，把「处刑分」做成了一套作秀系统。
items.noteEn: Whip enemies into cacti then kick them mid-air — a skill-shot scoring system built for showboating.

items.title: 凯瑟琳
items.creator: Atlus
items.note: 推箱子与成人婚恋恐惧的诡异组合，噩梦关卡是真正的硬核考验。
items.noteEn: Block-pushing welded to adult dread about commitment; the nightmare towers are genuinely brutal.

items.title: 黑暗之魂
items.creator: FromSoftware
items.note: 以地图咬合与信息碎片撑起难度，死亡不是惩罚而是世界运转的语法。
items.noteEn: Interlocking maps and cryptic lore underpin the difficulty — death is not punishment but the world's grammar.

items.title: 传送门2
items.creator: Valve
items.note: 把凝胶、光束与时光机制全数展开的双人合作解谜，剧本与演出媲美电影。
items.noteEn: Gels, beams and time mechanics unfold into a co-op puzzle epic with movie-grade writing and staging.

items.title: 太空化学
items.creator: Zachtronics
items.note: 编写化学工厂的反应管线，是 Zachtronics 编程解谜传统的开山之作。
items.noteEn: Program reaction pipelines in a chemistry factory; the template for Zachtronics' coding-puzzle lineage.

items.title: 上古卷轴5：天际
items.creator: Bethesda Game Studios
items.note: 龙吼与天际省的山谷雪原把『随便往哪走都有事做』变成了一种世界观而非功能。
items.noteEn: Dragon shouts and snowy valleys made 'go anywhere, find something' a worldview rather than a feature.

items.title: 全面战争：幕府将军 2
items.creator: Creative Assembly
items.note: 回合制治国与实时合战的无缝结合，是战国题材策略的巅峰答卷。
items.noteEn: Turn-based realm management fused with real-time battles — the definitive Sengoku strategy game.

items.title: 十字军之王 2
items.creator: Paradox Development Studio
items.note: 你不是在统治国家，而是在扮演一个会恋爱、会暗杀、也会死于感冒的贵族。
items.noteEn: You don't rule a nation — you play a noble who falls in love, plots murder and dies of a cold.

items.title: 欧洲卡车模拟 2
items.creator: SCS Software
items.note: 把「开卡车送货」做成养老型治愈，电台配乐让每一公里都变成享受。
items.noteEn: Trucking as a cozy retirement sim — radio, autobahn and endless delivery zen.

items.title: 孤岛惊魂3
items.creator: Ubisoft Montreal
items.note: 瓦斯的丛林与反派 Vaas 的疯言疯语，让『信号塔开图』从此成了开放世界标配。
items.noteEn: Rook Island's jungle and Vaas's madness made radio-tower map-unlocking a genre default.

items.title: 菲斯
items.creator: Polytron Corporation
items.note: 通过旋转视角把 2D 世界变成 3D 谜题的像素冒险，纯手工绘制的美术充满谜语。
items.noteEn: A pixel-art adventure that rotates a 2D world into 3D puzzles, wrapped in handmade visuals and hidden riddles.

items.title: 极限竞速：地平线
items.creator: Playground Games
items.note: 把科罗拉多州做成音乐节般的开放世界，竞速第一次有了「假期感」。
items.noteEn: Colorado as an open-world music festival — the first racer that felt like a road trip.

items.title: 超越光速
items.creator: Subset Games
items.note: 逐房间管理飞船能源与船员的一击毙命 roguelike，每次跃迁都可能终结旅程。
items.noteEn: Manage a spaceship room-by-room under permadeath pressure; every jump may be your last.

items.title: 迈阿密热线
items.creator: Dennaton Games
items.note: 霓虹与电子乐包裹的极速杀戮，一击必死的规则把每一次出击都变成精确规划。
items.noteEn: Neon-soaked, synth-driven ultraviolence where one-hit deaths turn every sweep into a precise plan.

items.title: 风之旅人
items.creator: thatgamecompany
items.note: 用无文字的沙漠漫游让陌生玩家彼此合作同行，Austin Wintory 的配乐是点睛之笔。
items.noteEn: A wordless desert pilgrimage where strangers cooperate wordlessly; Wintory's score is the soul of it.

items.title: 热血无赖
items.creator: United Front Games
items.note: 香港霓虹与功夫擒拿，警匪卧底戏在雨夜街巷里打出一套硬桥硬马。
items.noteEn: Hong Kong neon and kung-fu takedowns — an undercover cop drama staged in rain-slick alleys.

items.title: 特殊行动：一线生机
items.creator: Yager Development
items.note: 表面是掩体射击，内里是对「战争英雄叙事」的反战控诉，白磷弹一幕令人难忘。
items.noteEn: A cover shooter that indicts war-hero narratives — the white-phosphorus scene is unforgettable.

items.title: 洞穴探险
items.creator: Mossmouth
items.note: 程序生成洞穴的 roguelike 平台游戏始祖，每个陷阱都能相互联动制造意外死亡。
items.noteEn: The roguelike platformer that pioneered procedural caves where every trap chains into a glorious death.

items.title: 海市蜃楼之馆
items.creator: Novectacle
items.note: 被诅咒之馆横跨千年的悲剧群像，哥特式的爱与赎罪让人久久无法出戏。
items.noteEn: A cursed mansion's thousand-year tragedy; Gothic love and atonement that stays with you long after.

items.title: 谜室
items.creator: Fireproof Games
items.note: 把触屏滑动做成的立体机关盒解谜，手感细腻到每个旋钮都像真实存在。
items.noteEn: Touch-driven puzzle boxes so tactile every knob feels real; a landmark of mobile puzzle craft.

items.title: 极限脱出 善人死亡
items.creator: Spike Chunsoft
items.note: 把囚徒困境搬进密室逃脱，剧情树分支庞大到需要用流程图来导航。
items.noteEn: Prisoner's dilemma inside escape rooms; its branching story tree is so wide it needs a flowchart.

items.title: XCOM：未知敌人
items.creator: Firaxis Games
items.note: 把 95% 命中率打空的绝望与基地经营绑定，让每一次失败都刻骨铭心。
items.noteEn: Binds the despair of a 95% shot that misses to base management — every loss cuts deep.

items.title: 刀塔 2
items.creator: Valve
items.note: 一个英雄只给四个技能，减法设计却孕育出全世界最深的竞技体系之一。
items.noteEn: One hero, four buttons — an economy of design that bred one of the deepest competitive scenes on Earth.

items.title: 欧陆风云 4
items.creator: Paradox Development Studio
items.note: 从 1444 到 1821 的四百年代理棋，贸易、宗教与王朝阴谋织成一张巨网。
items.noteEn: Four hundred years of grand strategy from 1444 — trade, religion and dynastic intrigue in one web.

items.title: FIFA 14
items.creator: EA Canada
items.note: 首次引入「纯正射门」与物理引擎的 FIFA，是把足球模拟带上新台阶的一作。
items.noteEn: Introduced pure shot physics to the franchise; a milestone in making virtual football feel real.

items.title: 侠盗猎车手5
items.creator: Rockstar North
items.note: 三位主角的切人与合流让抢劫不再是任务而是编排，洛圣都的讽刺光谱亮到刺眼。
items.noteEn: Three protagonists and heists as choreography — Los Santos' satire is bright enough to sting.

items.title: 逃生
items.creator: Red Barrels
items.note: 全程只能靠夜视摄影机逃亡的精神病院之旅，电量与恐惧同步耗尽。
items.noteEn: Flee a mental asylum with only a night-vision camcorder; batteries and nerve drain together.

items.title: 请出示证件
items.creator: 3909 LLC
items.note: 扮演边境检查员在无数细则中辨认伪造文件，把道德抉择塞进一张张小卡片里。
items.noteEn: Play a border inspector flagging forged documents; it turns moral choice into a stack of tiny stamps.

items.title: 雷曼：传奇
items.creator: Ubisoft Montpellier
items.note: 手绘关卡与音乐节奏关的同步演出，多人接力让这场水彩冒险像乐队合奏。
items.noteEn: Hand-drawn stages and rhythm levels synced to music — co-op makes the watercolor romp play like a band.

items.title: 最后生还者
items.creator: Naughty Dog
items.note: 把僵尸末世写成一部公路片，乔尔与艾莉的关系弧线比感染本身更致命。
items.noteEn: A zombie apocalypse told as a road movie — Joel and Ellie's bond cuts deeper than the infection.

items.title: 古墓丽影（2013）
items.creator: Crystal Dynamics
items.note: 用求生与攀爬重启劳拉，从温室少女到独当一面的成长写得比机关更动人。
items.noteEn: Survival and climbing reboot Lara — her arc from green girl to survivor outshines the traps.

items.title: 异形：隔离
items.creator: Creative Assembly
items.note: 异形由 AI 驱动、无法预判行踪，把一个猎手放进永远不能放松的太空站。
items.noteEn: An AI-driven Xenomorph that learns and hunts you across a space station; you can never relax.

items.title: 神力科莎
items.creator: Kunos Simulazioni
items.note: 面向硬核玩家的物理引擎与激光扫描赛道，靠 MOD 生态长盛不衰。
items.noteEn: A physics engine built for hardcore sim racers — laser-scanned tracks and mods keep it alive.

items.title: 声名狼藉：次子
items.creator: Sucker Punch Productions
items.note: 西雅图的霓虹与烟尘，善与恶两套超能力树让『选择』有了看得见的后果。
items.noteEn: Neon Seattle where karmic power trees make every choice visibly reshape the city.

items.title: 纪念碑谷
items.creator: ustwo games
items.note: 以视错觉与埃舍尔式建筑打造的极简几何之旅，每一帧都是壁纸。
items.noteEn: Escher-esque optical illusions in minimalist geometry; every frame is a wallpaper.

items.title: PT
items.creator: Kojima Productions
items.note: 可玩预告片用一段循环走廊颠覆了整代恐怖游戏，可惜最终随项目取消而绝版。
items.noteEn: A playable teaser that reinvented horror in one looping corridor, delisted forever with Silent Hills.

items.title: 铲子骑士
items.creator: Yacht Club Games
items.note: 以 8-bit 风格复刻红白机时代手感的高完成度动作平台游戏，关卡设计堪称教科书。
items.noteEn: An 8-bit revival that nails NES-era feel; its level design is a masterclass in retro platforming.

items.title: 恶灵附身
items.creator: Tango Gameworks
items.note: 三上真司回归生存恐怖的执念之作，场景在精神世界与现实间反复扭曲。
items.noteEn: Shinji Mikami's return to survival horror; reality warps between mind and matter without mercy.

items.title: 晶体管
items.creator: Supergiant Games
items.note: 以巨剑里寄存的爱人声音为叙述者，实时与回合制融合的战斗华丽而伤感。
items.noteEn: A sword that carries a lover's voice narrates; real-time and turn-based combat melt into melancholy beauty.

items.title: 看门狗
items.creator: Ubisoft Montreal
items.note: 芝加哥的摄像头与手机入侵，把整座城市变成可破解的界面，是黑客视角开放世界的先行者。
items.noteEn: Chicago's CCTV and phone-hacking render the whole city as a hackable interface — the hacker's open world, first try.

items.title: 血源诅咒
items.creator: FromSoftware
items.note: 维多利亚哥特与克苏鲁畸变咬合，锯肉刀与内脏暴击鼓励以攻代守的近身狂舞。
items.noteEn: Victorian gothic meets Lovecraftian horror — sawblades and visceral attacks reward aggressive, close-range dancing.

items.title: 城市：天际线
items.creator: Colossal Order
items.note: 交通建模细致到每一条匝道，是《模拟城市》玩家集体流亡后的应许之地。
items.noteEn: Traffic modeled down to every off-ramp — the promised land SimCity players fled to.

items.title: 节奏地牢
items.creator: Brace Yourself Games
items.note: 把 roguelike 行动锁定到节拍上的天才融合，打拍子即走位、即杀敌。
items.noteEn: Roguelike movement locked to a beat; every step and strike must land on the downbeat.

items.title: 辐射4
items.creator: Bethesda Game Studios
items.note: 定居点建造与动力甲改装让废土变成可经营的沙盘，『义勇军将军』是带着锤子的幻想。
items.noteEn: Settlement building and power-armor mods turn the wasteland into a sandbox you can run with a hammer.

items.title: 人力资源机器
items.creator: Tomorrow Corporation
items.note: 把汇编语言包装成办公室小职员的任务，编程概念在欢笑中自然习得。
items.noteEn: Assembly programming disguised as office busywork; coding concepts sneak in through giggles.

items.title: 保持通话，没人爆炸
items.creator: Steel Crate Games
items.note: 一人拆弹、同伴翻手册指路的 VR 经典，把沟通失误变成最欢乐的爆炸现场。
items.noteEn: One player defuses, friends read the manual; miscommunication becomes the funniest blast.

items.title: 坎巴拉太空计划
items.creator: Squad
items.note: 用真实的轨道力学把火箭送上天的沙盒，是一代人的航天物理启蒙。
items.noteEn: Real orbital mechanics in a rocket sandbox — the aerospace physics primer a generation deserved.

items.title: 奥日与黑暗森林
items.creator: Moon Studios
items.note: 塞尔达式的技能成长配上手绘森林与催泪开场，把银河城做成一首长镜头诗。
items.noteEn: Metroidvania growth, hand-painted forest and a gut-punch prologue — the genre as a long-take poem.

items.title: 火箭联盟
items.creator: Psyonix
items.note: 把足球与喷气赛车拼在一起的奇想，物理掌握到极致后就是电子竞技天花板。
items.noteEn: Soccer with rocket cars; mastered physics turn it into one of esports' most skill-expressive titles.

items.title: 活体脑细胞
items.creator: Frictional Games
items.note: 深海基地里拷问意识与复制体的科幻恐怖，惊吓背后是令人失眠的哲学。
items.noteEn: Sci-fi dread in an underwater base probing consciousness; the horror lingers as sleepless philosophy.

items.title: 斯普拉遁
items.creator: Nintendo EAD
items.note: 用墨水涂地代替爆头计数，证明射击游戏不必总是灰暗与血腥的。
items.noteEn: Inking turf instead of counting headshots — proof that a shooter doesn't have to be grim.

items.title: 巫师3：狂猎
items.creator: CD Projekt Red
items.note: 猎魔人的支线没有对错只有代价，血腥男爵的故事证明 RPG 的良心藏在字里行间。
items.noteEn: Side quests with no right answers, only costs — the Bloody Baron proves an RPG's conscience lives in its writing.

items.title: 传说之下
items.creator: Toby Fox
items.note: 你可以不杀任何一个怪物通关，弹幕式的战斗与幽默旁白彻底颠覆 RPG 的常规。
items.noteEn: Mercy as a victory condition turns the violence loop back on the player — beneath the pixels, pure rules.

items.title: 直到黎明
items.creator: Supermassive Games
items.note: 把好莱坞恐怖片变成可玩交互，蝴蝶效应让每个角色的生死都由你的选择决定。
items.noteEn: A playable slasher movie where butterfly-effect choices decide who survives the cabin night.

items.title: 如龙0
items.creator: Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio
items.note: 神室町的烟火气与八十年代泡沫经济，让街头打架和小游戏都成了庶民史诗。
items.noteEn: Kamurocho's neon bustle and the bubble economy make street brawls and minigames into an everyman epic.

items.title: 黑暗之魂3
items.creator: FromSoftware
items.note: 把前两代的武器与地图做了终曲式缝合，灰烬的余火在薪王传说里烧到最后。
items.noteEn: A finale suturing the first two games' gear and vistas — the Ashen One carries the embers to the end.

items.title: 毁灭战士 2016
items.creator: id Software
items.note: 用处决回血取代掩体，把「射爆一切」本身做成了一套优雅自洽的循环。
items.noteEn: Glory kills replace cover — a perfectly elegant loop built entirely around ripping demons apart.

items.title: 钢铁雄心 4
items.creator: Paradox Development Studio
items.note: 从「柏林之路」国策树到自绘装甲师徽章，是全二战史的军宅狂欢。
items.noteEn: From the Berlin Express focus tree to custom tank-division emblems — a full-warfare military history sandbox.

items.title: 光明旅者
items.creator: Heart Machine
items.note: 没有一句对白的 16-bit 动作冒险，节奏凌厉、残影美学，向《暗黑破坏神》致敬的地城战斗。
items.noteEn: A wordless 16-bit action-adventure with sharp, afterimage-soaked combat that evokes Diablo's dungeons.

items.title: Inside
items.creator: Playdead
items.note: 《地狱边境》团队打造的黑色反乌托邦解谜，压抑氛围在结局达到令人不安的高潮。
items.noteEn: Playdead's dystopian puzzle-platformer whose suffocating mood crescendos into a haunting final act.

items.title: 无人深空
items.creator: Hello Games
items.note: 一亿八千万颗星球程序生成，从发售翻车到八年补全，是『承诺』与『救赎』并存的活标本。
items.noteEn: 18 quintillion procedural planets, from launch disaster to eight years of updates — a living monument to redemption.

items.title: 守望先锋
items.creator: Blizzard Entertainment
items.note: 把 MOBA 的职责分工塞进 6v6 射击，用英雄与高饱和配色重构了团队对抗。
items.noteEn: MOBA-style roles distilled into 6v6 shooting, reimagining team combat around heroes and color.

items.title: 奥森弗里
items.creator: Night School Studio
items.note: 电台频率扰动时空的超自然青少年群像，对话在行走与打断中自然生长。
items.noteEn: A supernatural teen story where radio frequencies tear time; dialogue flows through interruption and movement.

items.title: 过山车之星
items.creator: Frontier Developments
items.note: 造景自由度堪比专业建模软件，让「主题乐园设计师」成了热门虚拟职业。
items.noteEn: Scenery tools rivaling pro modeling software — a virtual career for theme-park designers.

items.title: 星露谷物语
items.creator: ConcernedApe
items.note: 一人开发四年的田园经营经典，种田、采矿、恋爱与小镇节庆层层叠叠地填满生活感。
items.noteEn: Built by one developer over four years; farming, mining, romance and festivals stack into a lived-in town.

items.title: 群星
items.creator: Paradox Development Studio
items.note: 把《文明》的探索搬进银河系，虫子、机器与灵能文明在同一片星海崛起。
items.noteEn: Civilization-style exploration scaled to the galaxy, where bugs, bots and psionics all rise.

items.title: 斯蒂芬的香肠卷
items.creator: Increpare Games
items.note: 只用滚肠与烤炉就构筑出令人绝望的拓扑难题，硬核解谜玩家的圣杯。
items.noteEn: Just a sausage and a grill yield agonizing topological puzzles; a holy grail for hardcore solvers.

items.title: 杰克盒派对合集3
items.creator: Jackbox Games
items.note: 手机当手柄的答题派对合集，《Quiplash》让损友金句成为全场笑点。
items.noteEn: A phone-as-controller quiz party; Quiplash turns your friends' dumbest answers into the show.

items.title: 见证者
items.creator: Thekla, Inc.
items.note: 一座岛上千条线谜题，规则从不说明却能被直觉与观察学会。
items.noteEn: An island of line puzzles whose rules are never told yet learned through observation and epiphany.

items.title: 重击者
items.creator: Drool
items.note: 以金属节拍撞击轨道的高速恐怖音游，狂暴视听把玩家推向节奏深渊。
items.noteEn: A violent rhythm racer slamming a beetle through hyperspeed tunnels; it weaponizes the beat.

items.title: 泰坦陨落 2
items.creator: Respawn Entertainment
items.note: 单机关卡「Effect and Cause」把双时间线玩出花，是近十年最被低估的 FPS 战役之一。
items.noteEn: The time-shift level 'Effect and Cause' is one of the decade's most underrated FPS campaigns.

items.title: 神秘海域4：盗贼末路
items.creator: Naughty Dog
items.note: 兄弟情与盗墓史的纠缠给了德雷克一个体面的退场，钩索与载具把线性关卡玩出开放感。
items.noteEn: A brother's return gives Drake a dignified exit, while rope-swinging and vehicles widen the linear stages into openness.

items.title: 赛博朋克酒保行动
items.creator: Sukeban Games
items.note: 在霓虹酒馆调酒听客人倾诉的赛博朋克日常，调酒配方本身就是故事线索。
items.noteEn: Mix drinks and listen to a neon city's regulars; every cocktail recipe doubles as story.

items.title: 茶杯头
items.creator: Studio MDHR
items.note: 逐帧手绘的 1930 年代橡皮管动画风格跑轰游戏，BOSS 战如同会动的老电影。
items.noteEn: A run-and-gun rendered in hand-drawn 1930s rubber-hose animation; boss fights move like old cartoons.

items.title: 神界：原罪2
items.creator: Larian Studios
items.note: 元素地表与物理环境互相点火，行动自由到连 NPC 都可以是经验值——或是队友。
items.noteEn: Elemental surfaces and physics interplay; freedom so total that NPCs can be XP — or party members.

items.title: 心跳文学部
items.creator: Team Salvato
items.note: 披着恋爱喜剧外衣的元恐怖，越界修改文件的那一刻起就再也回不了头。
items.noteEn: A dating-sim shell hiding meta-horror; once it starts editing its own files, you cannot unsee it.

items.title: 勇者斗恶龙11
items.creator: Square Enix (Armor Project)
items.note: 鸟山明人设与椙山浩一的交响乐，把王道 RPG 的『确定感』打磨成安心与感动。
items.noteEn: Toriyama's art and Sugiyama's symphonies polish the comfort of a classic JRPG into pure reassurance.

items.title: 群殴野兽
items.creator: Boneloaf
items.note: 软体布偶互殴的物理格斗派对，僵硬到极致的打斗反而笑料百出。
items.noteEn: Gelatinous brawlers fight with hilariously floppy physics; every punch is a pratfall.

items.title: 空洞骑士
items.creator: Team Cherry
items.note: 圣巢的地下遗迹层层咬合，手绘虫族与晦暗叙事让银河城的探索带上了考古味。
items.noteEn: A hand-drawn insect kingdom Metroidvania so vast it invites getting lost; combat and exploration feel superb.

items.title: 地平线：零之曙光
items.creator: Guerrilla Games
items.note: 机械恐龙与部落图腾交错，用考古叙事揭开文明崩坏的真相，阿洛伊是近十年最有说服力的新英雄。
items.noteEn: Machine-dinosaurs meet tribal totems; archaeology-driven lore explains the fall — Aloy is the decade's most credible new hero.

items.title: 小小梦魇
items.creator: Tarsier Studios
items.note: 黄雨衣小人穿过巨型怪物的邮轮，尺寸反差把恐惧做成精致的黑暗童话。
items.noteEn: A child in a yellow raincoat crawls through a giant's ship; scale becomes a delicate dark fairy tale.

items.title: 马力欧卡丁车8 豪华版
items.creator: Nintendo
items.note: 蓝龟壳与道具乱斗的国民赛车，把竞速变成人人能赢的派对狂欢。
items.noteEn: Item-fueled chaos on the track; the blue shell keeps every racer one spin away from losing.

items.title: 尼尔：机械纪元
items.creator: PlatinumGames
items.note: 2B 的视角在 2D、弹幕与砍杀间切换，多周目结局用『删除存档』逼你直面意义。
items.noteEn: 2B's view shifts between 2D, bullet-hell and slashing; the finale asks you to delete your save to mean it.

items.title: 杰出之作
items.creator: Zachtronics
items.note: 用机械臂搭建炼金流水线，解法没有唯一答案，只有更优雅的答案。
items.noteEn: Build alchemy assembly lines with robotic arms; there is no right answer, only more elegant ones.

items.title: 噗哟噗哟俄罗斯方块
items.creator: Sega
items.note: 两种国民级消除规则的梦幻联动，跨规则对战让节奏与策略激烈碰撞。
items.noteEn: Two national puzzle rules collide in cross-mode battles where timing and strategy clash.

items.title: 生化危机7
items.creator: Capcom
items.note: 第一人称视角回归密室恐怖，贝克一家的美国南方邪典味浓到化不开。
items.noteEn: First-person survival returns to cramped dread; the Baker family drips Southern Gothic menace.

items.title: 索尼克狂热
items.creator: Headcannon & PagodaWest Games
items.note: 老粉丝手作的新关卡把 2D 索尼克的速度哲学复活，是官方重拾初心的最好示范。
items.noteEn: Fan-made new zones revive 2D Sonic's speed philosophy — proof the franchise's heart was never lost.

items.title: 超级马力欧：奥德赛
items.creator: Nintendo EPD
items.note: 附身系统让每个敌人都是新玩具，全球各地的王国与月亮收集把开放探索装进箱庭。
items.noteEn: Capturing enemies turns everyone into a toy; worldwide kingdoms and moons pack open exploration into dioramas.

items.title: 铁拳7
items.creator: Bandai Namco Studios
items.note: 用虚幻引擎表现 3D 格斗的帧级手感，三岛家族恩怨在最终章落幕。
items.noteEn: Unreal Engine polish on frame-perfect 3D combat; the Mishima saga reaches its final showdown.

items.title: 塞尔达传说：旷野之息
items.en: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
items.creator: Nintendo EPD
items.note: 把『好奇心即攻略』推向极致：爬山、滑翔与物理相互作用取代了路标，玩家自己书写路线。
items.noteEn: Championed curiosity-as-guide: climbing, gliding and physics interactions replace waypoints, letting players write their own routes.

items.title: 全面战争：战锤 2
items.creator: Creative Assembly
items.note: 魔法、巨兽与漩涡仪式战，把中古战锤的疯狂搬上宏大战役地图。
items.noteEn: Magic, monsters and vortex ritual battles bring the Warhammer Old World's madness to the campaign map.

items.title: 刺客信条：奥德赛
items.creator: Ubisoft Quebec
items.note: 古希腊的每座山都藏着一个神话，育碧把历史旅游做成了刺客信条的招牌。
items.noteEn: Every Greek peak hides a myth — Ubisoft turned historical tourism into Assassin's Creed's calling card.

items.title: 节奏光剑
items.creator: Beat Games
items.note: 用 VR 光剑切开迎面而来的音符，把健身与音游合二为一的杀手级作品。
items.noteEn: Slice incoming beats with VR sabers; the killer app that fused fitness with rhythm games.

items.title: 蔚蓝
items.creator: Maddy Makes Games
items.note: 把登山的挫败感写进『协助模式』与剧情，玛德琳的焦虑和玩家的手柄一起深呼吸。
items.noteEn: It builds the climb's frustration into its assist mode and story — Madeline's anxiety breathes with your controller.

items.title: 龙珠斗士Z
items.creator: Arc System Works
items.note: 2.5D 手绘质感的 3v3 组队战，把龙珠的瞬移与对波做成行云流水的格斗，拿下 2018 TGA 最佳格斗游戏。
items.noteEn: Hand-drawn 2.5D 3v3 battles translate Dragon Ball's teleports and ki blasts into fluid fighting — TGA 2018 Best Fighting Game.

items.title: 冰汽时代
items.creator: 11 bit studios
items.note: 当世界只剩零下 150 度，你会签下童工法案，还是看着整座城市冻死？
items.noteEn: When the world freezes to -150°C, do you sign the child-labor law or watch the city die?

items.title: 战神（2018）
items.creator: Santa Monica Studio
items.note: 把希腊战神塞进北欧神话与父子关系，一镜到底的镜头把斧头投掷玩成了抒情。
items.noteEn: A Greek god remade for Norse myth and fatherhood, with a single-shot camera making the axe throw lyrical.

items.title: 格丽斯
items.creator: Nomada Studio
items.note: 水彩画般的解谜平台游戏，色彩随主角情绪逐渐苏醒，全程无文字却极富感染力。
items.noteEn: A watercolor puzzle-platformer where color returns with the heroine's grief; wordless yet deeply moving.

items.title: 陷阵之志
items.creator: Subset Games
items.note: 每回合都能推演敌人行动的小型棋盘策略，把挫败感做成值得反复咀嚼的难题。
items.noteEn: Turn-based tactics shrunk to an 8x8 grid where enemies telegraph every move — victory by shove and push.

items.title: 漫威蜘蛛侠
items.creator: Insomniac Games
items.note: 蛛网摆荡的物理手感是曼哈顿的通行证，漫画式演出让超级英雄第一次有了体重。
items.noteEn: Web-swinging physics is the ticket to Manhattan; comic-book beats give a superhero real gravity.

items.title: 胡闹厨房2
items.creator: Ghost Town Games
items.note: 在会移动的厨房里分工烹饪，是检验友情与默契的终极压力测试。
items.noteEn: Coordinate a kitchen on moving platforms; the ultimate stress test for friendships.

items.title: 荒野大镖客：救赎2
items.creator: Rockstar Games
items.note: 营地兄弟情与马匹毛发的物理细节，把西部开放世界做成一件能触摸的标本。
items.noteEn: Camp brotherhood and horse-grooming physics make the frontier an open world you can touch.

items.title: 奥伯拉·丁的回归
items.creator: 3909 LLC
items.note: 用一帧帧死亡瞬间拼凑沉船船员身份的海上悬案，1-bit 美术下是极其精密的推理。
items.noteEn: Reconstruct a lost ship's crew from frozen death moments; under 1-bit art hides razor-sharp deduction.

items.title: 环世界
items.creator: Ludeon Studios
items.note: AI 讲故事机：一场疯狗袭击就能毁掉三年的殖民地，然后变成传奇。
items.noteEn: An AI storyteller — one mad-dog raid can topple a three-year colony, then become legend.

items.title: 任天堂明星大乱斗 特别版
items.creator: Bandai Namco Studios
items.note: 收录历代全部角色的「全明星」阵容，是任天堂跨世代 IP 的终极庆典。
items.noteEn: Every fighter in series history returns; the ultimate crossover celebration of Nintendo's IP.

items.title: 俄罗斯方块效应
items.creator: Monstars / Resonair
items.note: 在经典规则上叠加声光电的沉浸式演出，通关时的通感体验近乎冥想。
items.noteEn: Classic rules under a synesthetic light-and-sound show; clearing the final stage feels like meditation.

items.title: 双点医院
items.creator: Two Point Studios
items.note: 《主题医院》的精神续作，用英式冷幽默处理「头晕病」与光怪陆离的疑难杂症。
items.noteEn: Theme Hospital's spiritual heir, treating lightheadedness and other absurd ailments with British wit.

items.title: 巴巴是你
items.creator: Hempuli
items.note: 用词块改写关卡规则本身，把「推箱子」扩展成可编程的逻辑宇宙。
items.noteEn: Push words that rewrite the rules of the level; it turns Sokoban into a programmable logic universe.

items.title: 死亡搁浅
items.creator: Kojima Productions
items.note: 把『送快递』做成连接主义寓言，山峦与雨雪让每一步负重都有意义，是反暴力开放世界的宣言。
items.noteEn: Package delivery as a connectivity fable — every loaded step through rain and rock matters; an anti-violent open world.

items.title: 尘埃拉力赛 2.0
items.creator: Codemasters
items.note: 领航员口播与动态路面损毁，把拉力赛的紧张感压进每一次刹车。
items.noteEn: Co-driver calls and a dynamic surface model deliver rally tension in every braking zone.

items.title: 极乐迪斯科
items.creator: ZA/UM
items.note: 侦探的外衣下是彻底的意识形态与自我对话，24 种技能让内心戏成为主要玩法。
items.noteEn: Beneath a detective premise lies pure ideology and self-talk; 24 skills make your inner monologue the gameplay.

items.title: 火焰之纹章：风花雪月
items.creator: Intelligent Systems
items.note: 学院日常与五年后战场的双时段结构，让每场战斗都背负着人情债。
items.noteEn: Monastery life and a five-year jump make every battle carry the weight of old bonds.

items.title: 真人快打11
items.creator: NetherRealm Studios
items.note: 以极致血腥终结技闻名的格斗系列，故事模式拍得像院线动作片。
items.noteEn: Notorious for its gory fatalities; the story mode alone plays like a blockbuster action film.

items.title: 星际拓荒
items.creator: Mobius Digital
items.note: 太阳系每 22 分钟毁灭一次的宇宙解谜，所有知识都靠玩家亲自探索获得。
items.noteEn: A solar system that explodes every 22 minutes; every clue is knowledge you earn through exploration.

items.title: 女神异闻录5 皇家版
items.creator: Atlus
items.note: 怪盗团在东京的日常与宫殿双线并进，视觉与爵士配乐把高中生造反写成风格宣言。
items.noteEn: Tokyo's daily life runs parallel to Palace heists; style and jazz turn teenage rebellion into a manifesto.

items.title: 动物园之星
items.creator: Frontier Developments
items.note: 每只动物都带遗传与行为模型，经营之下更像一座活的生态博物馆。
items.noteEn: Every animal has genetics and behavior — a living museum beneath the management game.

items.title: 生化危机2 重制版
items.creator: Capcom
items.note: 以现代引擎重建浣熊市的暴君追逐，恐怖与弹药管理的紧张感精准复刻。
items.noteEn: Raccoon City rebuilt in a modern engine; Mr. X's pursuit keeps tension and ammo scarcity razor-sharp.

items.title: 再见狂野之心
items.creator: Simogo
items.note: 流媒体流行乐的梦幻跑酷，霓虹、心碎与骑行在 90 分钟里一气呵成。
items.noteEn: A dream-pop on-rails arcade ride; neon, heartbreak and motorcycles in one euphoric 90 minutes.

items.title: 只狼：影逝二度
items.creator: FromSoftware
items.note: 以『架势』取代血条、以弹反定胜负，把剑戟决斗还原成节奏与呼吸的博弈。
items.noteEn: Posture replaces health bars — deflection decides duels, reducing sword fights to rhythm and breath.

items.title: 杀戮尖塔
items.creator: Mega Crit Games
items.note: 卡牌构建 × Roguelike 的祖师爷，每一次抓牌都是一场与随机性的谈判。
items.noteEn: The deckbuilder-roguelike progenitor — every card pick is a negotiation with randomness.

items.title: 无名之鹅
items.creator: House House
items.note: 扮演一只在村庄里到处捣乱的鹅，把「恶作剧清单」玩成行为艺术。
items.noteEn: Play a mischievous goose terrorizing a village; a checklist of pranks turned into performance art.

items.title: 怪物的远征
items.creator: Draknek & Friends
items.note: 用漂流的原木搭桥横穿群岛的开放解谜，规则简单到一句话却无穷无尽。
items.noteEn: Rafting across an archipelago with floating logs; one-sentence rules spiral into endless puzzles.

items.title: 集合啦！动物森友会
items.creator: Nintendo EPD
items.note: 一座荒岛在真实时间里缓缓成形，成为疫情隔离期千万人的情感缓冲垫。
items.noteEn: An island shaping itself in real time — the emotional cushion millions needed during lockdown.

items.title: 赛博朋克2077
items.creator: CD Projekt Red
items.note: 夜之城的霓虹密度无出其右，历经修葺与《往日之影》后，它终于兑现了『赛博朋克』的承诺。
items.noteEn: Night City's neon density is unmatched; after patches and Phantom Liberty, it finally keeps its cyberpunk promise.

items.title: 异星工厂
items.creator: Wube Software
items.note: 传送带与机械臂的自动化诗歌，「再优化一条产线就睡」是最甜蜜的时间黑洞。
items.noteEn: An automated symphony of belts and inserters — the time-sink that outgrew its own factory.

items.title: 原神
items.creator: miHoYo
items.note: 把开放世界搬上手机并做成长线更新，提瓦特的七国地图与抽卡范式改写了大作的下沉方式。
items.noteEn: Open world on phones with a live-service cadence — Teyvat's map and gacha model rewrote how big games reach everyone.

items.title: 对马岛之魂
items.creator: Sucker Punch Productions
items.note: 对马岛的俳句、风引与决斗姿态让武士片活了过来，黑白模式『黑泽』是献给电影的情书。
items.noteEn: Haiku, wind-guided travel and duel stances revive the chanbara film — the Kurosawa mode is a love letter to cinema.

items.title: 哈迪斯
items.creator: Supergiant Games
items.note: 把 roguelike 的死亡循环写成逃离冥界的神话，故事在每次失败中持续推进。
items.noteEn: A roguelike escape from the underworld where narrative advances with every death; myth made iterative.

items.title: 微软模拟飞行
items.creator: Asobo Studio
items.note: 卫星测绘让整个地球都可飞，机外视角里的云海是工程与视觉的双重奇观。
items.noteEn: The whole planet flyable via satellite data — cloudscapes that are a feat of engineering and art.

items.title: 奥日与萤火意志
items.en: Ori and the Will of the Wisps
items.creator: Moon Studios
items.note: 灰烬森林的机关密度与大型 Boss 战补齐了系列短板，两作并看才是完整叙事。
items.noteEn: Denser challenges and real bosses fill the gaps of the first — together the two make a complete arc.

items.title: 最后生还者 第二部
items.en: The Last of Us Part II
items.creator: Naughty Dog
items.note: 用双主角视角逼你重审仇恨，艾比的出拳与艾莉的收刀同样沉重，复仇叙事由此反转。
items.noteEn: Dual protagonists force you to re-litigate revenge — Abby's blows and Ellie's retreat weigh equally.

items.title: 帝国时代 4
items.creator: Relic Entertainment
items.note: 纪录片式战役与全新文明机制，稳稳接住了老玩家二十年的期待。
items.noteEn: Documentary-style campaigns and fresh civ mechanics carry two decades of pent-up expectations.

items.title: 极限竞速：地平线 5
items.creator: Playground Games
items.note: 墨西哥的火山、雨林与沙漠同屏驰骋，是开放世界赛车目前的天花板。
items.noteEn: Volcano, jungle and desert in one Mexican map — the current ceiling of open-world racing.

items.title: 罪恶装备 奋战
items.creator: Arc System Works
items.note: 2D 手绘动画渲染到极致的格斗，华丽连段与重金属摇滚相得益彰。
items.noteEn: Hand-drawn anime fighters at peak fidelity; flashy combos meet a heavy-metal heart.

items.title: 邪恶冥刻
items.creator: Daniel Mullins Games
items.note: 卡片游戏外皮下藏着层层元叙事的惊悚，每拆开一层都让人脊背发凉。
items.noteEn: A card game wrapped in nested meta-horror; each layer you peel back chills the spine further.

items.title: 双人成行
items.creator: Hazelight Studios
items.note: 双人分屏强制协作，每关换一套玩法，把『关系修复』的主题做成了关卡本身。
items.noteEn: Forced co-op with a new mechanic every level — the theme of mending a relationship becomes the level design.

items.title: 马力欧派对 超级巨星
items.creator: NDcube
items.note: 复刻 N64 时代经典地图与小游戏，一掷骰子就让友谊翻脸如翻书。
items.noteEn: Classic N64 boards and minigames remastered; one dice roll is all it takes to end friendships.

items.title: 死亡回归
items.creator: Housemarque
items.note: 把 Roguelike 死亡循环与第三人称弹幕枪战嫁接，故障美学与身体恐怖同行。
items.noteEn: A roguelike death-loop fused with third-person bullet-hell — glitch aesthetic meets body horror.

items.title: 艾尔登法环
items.creator: FromSoftware
items.note: 无缝开放世界与魂系硬核咬合，骑马、骨灰与战灰让受苦变成一种可以被分享的朝圣。
items.noteEn: Open world fused with Souls difficulty — Torrent, spirit ashes and ashes' arts turn suffering into shared pilgrimage.

items.title: 战神：诸神黄昏
items.creator: Santa Monica Studio
items.note: 九界地图更立体、剧情锤点更重，阿特柔斯的成年礼与诸神黄昏同步降临。
items.noteEn: A more vertical Nine Realms and heavier emotional beats — Atreus' coming of age rides on Ragnarök's arrival.

items.title: 地平线：西之绝境
items.creator: Guerrilla Games
items.note: 旧金山废墟与热带雨林同框，飞行坐骑把地平线的垂直探索带上新高度。
items.noteEn: San Francisco ruins beside rainforests — a flying mount lifts Horizon's vertical exploration to new heights.

items.title: 漫威暗夜之子
items.creator: Firaxis Games
items.note: XCOM 团队的卡牌战棋让漫威角色同台斗法，可惜栽在了发行档期上。
items.noteEn: XCOM's card-based tactics meet Marvel's roster — a gem that fell victim to release timing.

items.title: 博德之门3
items.creator: Larian Studios
items.note: 骰子、环境互动与自由杀生的密度，让桌面规则在电脑上第一次有了呼吸感。
items.noteEn: Dice rolls, environmental trickery and goblin-killing freedom let tabletop rules breathe on PC for the first time.

items.title: 街头霸王6
items.creator: Capcom
items.note: 以「现代模式」降低入门门槛并保留深度，时隔多年让街霸回到主流视野。
items.noteEn: A 'Modern' control scheme lowers the bar without losing depth, reviving the franchise's mainstream pull.

items.title: 塞尔达传说：王国之泪
items.en: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
items.creator: Nintendo EPD
items.note: 在旷野之息的地基上抛出『究极手』合成系统，把整个世界变成可拆装、可组装的巨型道具箱。
items.noteEn: Adds the Ultrahand build system to BotW's world, turning the entire map into a kit of detachable, buildable parts.

items.title: 宇宙机器人
items.creator: Team Asobi
items.note: 把 PS5 手柄的触觉与自适应扳机做成关卡语言，复古致敬关卡的密度高到令人窒息。
items.noteEn: DualSense haptics and adaptive triggers become level grammar; the nostalgia levels are breathtakingly dense.
